emission_order.limit: Compile-order context only. It explains why a body mismatch may be a neighbor artifact; it never proves or masks any byte.
emission_order.note: Historical predecessor is emitted in order but does not match yet; its bytes may perturb this body.

known_rules.symptom: Instruction skeletons match, but aligned pointer operands reference different literal payloads.
known_rules.known_source_cause: Wrong filename format, file mode, default string, or formatting spaces can masquerade as relocation layout differences.
known_rules.known_fix_pattern: Use repair_literal_content when the card identifies unique explicit source tokens. It changes only those tokens. Equal content with unknown ownership stays blocked; original operand content is diagnostic evidence, not an independent relocation binding.

compiler_scope.acceptance: Fresh strict comparison, independently resolved relocations, neighbor preservation, ordinary link regression check and atomic publication.

applicability.limit: Symptom filtering narrows hypotheses; it does not prove the source cause or authorize a repair. Historical example membership alone is not current applicability.

routing_reason: Base eligibility checks not met: body_edit_allowed, historical_size_at_most_900, cheap_difference_class

routing_evidence.limit: Explains the base heuristic only. Recorded blocks, interface/owner prerequisites and proved bounded recipes take precedence; difficulty is the final routing decision.

callee_interface_scope.limit: Known direct-callee conflicts only. Verified call addresses do not prove declaration/type compatibility. Remote-only conflicts remain visible but do not block a proven local interface; unknown indirect targets are not inferred.

edit_scope: Function body only; use supervisor for prototypes/data/headers or missing implementations.
